decision.rationale: The source consistently uses Koeffizientenbereich for the generating coefficient role, while its definition of Zahlkörper explicitly permits a field containing all complex numbers. The selected pair preserves those roles. The inherited coefficient field overstates the first, and modern number field misleadingly narrows the second.
decision.reviewer_question: Should the cumulative reader add a short glossary note at the first Lagrange genus domain occurrence while leaving the coefficient-domain/scalar-field distinction in the body unobtrusive?
